Figure 2. Overview of AVION. Upper-left (Training Student). Learnable prompt tokens are injected into the text and vision encoders. The student outputs embeddings: tSk (student text embedding for class k) and vS i (visual embedding for image i). Bottom-left (Offline Teacher). LLM-based Domain Prompting generates multiple class-aware descriptions, which are encoded into tTk,j . Selective Prototype Aggregation verifies these candidates using teacher visual embeddings vT i and aggregates them into an RS-aware text prototype tT∗ k . Right (Training Objectives). Tri-aspect alignment: (i) textual alignment Ltext maximizes the cosine similarity between tSk and tT∗ k ; (ii) visual alignment Limg aligns vS i with vT i ; (iii) similarity logit alignment Llogit matches teacher logits sTi,k = (vT i ) ⊤tT∗ k and student logits sSi,k = (vS i ) ⊤tSk via temperature-scaled KL. A standard task loss Ltask (cross-entropy) is applied on the student.
